title: Recovery/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Alad V and Lotus transmissions when Zanuka Hunter spawns and during a Recovery mission.
- Alad V: "Tenno? Can you hear me? You've been a naughty little betrayer, haven't you? Did you really think your support for the Grineer would go unnoticed?"
- Alad V: "That is just the sort of behavior I just can't let go uncorrected. Otherwise, you'll never learn."
- Alad V: "This is really for your own good, Tenno. Help me, help you... help me."
- Alad V: "Good job Zanuka. This Tenno's bones will make you a fine sibling."
- Alad V: "Zanuka? No! What have you monsters done to my beautiful creature? I won't forget this."
- Lotus: "Tenno. Tenno can you hear me? You've been captured by Alad V's harvester. This is your chance, escape."
- Lotus: "Tenno. Ready yourself. You have been captured by the Corpus. It is time to escape."
- Alad V: "Oh, Tenno. I understand you're nervous. But if you come back to us I can assure you; you won't feel a thing."
- Alad V: "Tenno, don't listen to that... that Lotus. She just wants to hold you back. Stay with me explore your... potential."

- Alad V: "Tenno, Tenno! There's an entire Grineer battalion here to rescue you. Your friends must really appreciate your support. Wait, no. I'm mistaken. Your alone, with no weapons and no friends. Silly me."
- Alad V: "The Grineer are a threat to us all. You need to understand the error of you ways. Consider my efforts a favor... yes."
- Lotus: "I have extraction ready but you have to find your weapons first. Can you handle that?"
- Lotus: "You're not going to last long without your weapons, they are scattered around this facility. Find them."
- Lotus: "You found your primary weapon. Lock and load."
- Lotus: "You found all your weapons. Get out of there."
- Lotus: "You're done. Extraction is waiting. Go."
